summary: Iteration 8: Android APK Management feature — full backend (19/19 tests PASS) and frontend (upload, list, delete UI all PASS). One critical bug found: GET /api/apk/latest returns an internal Kubernetes cluster URL (http://apk-preview-env.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud/uploads/apk/...) that is NOT accessible externally (returns 301→403). Correct public URL is https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com/api/uploads/apk/... (returns 200).

critical.issue: download_url is built using request.base_url which returns the internal Kubernetes cluster hostname (apk-preview-env.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud), NOT the public external URL. Also uses /uploads/apk/ path which is not routable via Kubernetes ingress (only /api/* paths are proxied). Result: 301→403 when Android device tries to download. The correct accessible URL is https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com/api/uploads/apk/{filename}.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix download_url in apk.py — Two changes needed: (1) Change stored download_url from '/uploads/apk/{filename}' to '/api/uploads/apk/{filename}' (so Kubernetes ingress can route it). (2) Fix request.base_url to use the public hostname — add PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com to backend/.env and in get_latest_apk() use: base = os.environ.get('PUBLIC_BASE_URL', '').rstrip('/') or fall back to request.base_url. Without this fix, Android devices will get a 403 error when trying to download the APK.
critical_code_review_comments: apk.py get_latest_apk(): request.base_url returns the internal Kubernetes cluster URL. Must use a PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var instead. Additionally download_url stored as /uploads/apk/ but only /api/uploads/apk/ is accessible via ingress. Both paths need to be fixed in one PR.

apk.py: The delete endpoint only removes the DB record, NOT the file from /app/backend/uploads/apk/. Over time this will accumulate orphaned APK files on disk. Should also call os.remove() on the file.

apk.py get_db(): Creates its own MongoClient instance (_mongo) separate from server.py's global client — same dual-connection-pool issue noted in prior reviews for other route files. Minor resource inefficiency.

SettingsTab.jsx handleApkUpload(): Sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data manually — axios with FormData sets this automatically including the boundary. Setting it manually may omit the boundary and cause multipart parsing to fail in some environments. Should remove the explicit Content-Type header override.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 tests pass — but note: absolute URL test passes because URL starts with http://, not because it is actually accessible)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — All UI elements present and functional: file input, version/version_code/release_notes inputs, force-update checkbox, upload button, no-releases text, release list with version/code/delete button. Upload and delete flows work end-to-end.

seed_data_creation: Upload test left apk releases in DB during pytest run (cleaned up after each test class). UI test created and deleted v5.0.0 (code 5000) release — all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: APK management feature is fully implemented. The only outstanding bug is the download_url in GET /api/apk/latest returning an internal cluster URL + wrong /uploads/ path. After the fix, verify: curl https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com/api/apk/latest after an upload should return download_url starting with https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com/api/uploads/apk/ and that URL should return 200.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI's request.base_url reflects the internal Kubernetes cluster hostname (apk-preview-env.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud) instead of the external public hostname. This happens because the Kubernetes ingress does not forward X-Forwarded-Host headers that FastAPI could use to reconstruct the public URL. Additionally, the stored relative path /uploads/apk/ is only mounted directly on the backend; the Kubernetes ingress only routes /api/* paths to the backend, so /uploads/ is not externally accessible.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1. Upload any APK via POST /api/apk/upload. 2. Call GET /api/apk/latest. 3. Copy download_url value. 4. Try curl <download_url> — returns 301→403.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: In /app/backend/routes/apk.py: (1) Change line 113 to: download_url = f'/api/uploads/apk/{filename}'. (2) In get_latest_apk(), replace 'base = str(request.base_url).rstrip("/")' with: 'base = os.environ.get("PUBLIC_BASE_URL", str(request.base_url)).rstrip("/")'. (3) Add PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://vault-preview-38.preview.emergentagent.com to /app/backend/.env.
